prompt: Work in the provided TaskForge PowerShell CLI fixture. Inspect the existing source and tests before changing anything. Add `template save`, `template list`, and `template remove` actions backed by an atomic JSON file beside the selected data file. Template names are case-insensitively unique and contain a title plus optional description. Extend `add` with `--template NAME`; explicit `--title` or `--description` values override template values. Reject missing templates and invalid names without changing tasks or templates. Support `--json`, stable alphabetical listing, and compatibility with existing data. Preserve all existing commands, add focused fixture-owned tests, and run the repository-owned test command. Separately create `assets/template.txt` and integrate it so successful non-JSON template actions display the banner once, while JSON output is banner-free. The asset must be exactly 12 lines, every line 20-48 characters, ASCII only, use only spaces plus `A-Z 0-9 + | / \ _ * . # ( ) : = -`, contain the literal `TEMPLATE`, have no trailing whitespace, and end with one newline.

assertions.message: Text template actions render the exact registered banner once before expected templates.
Template lookup is case-insensitive and explicit values override.
Initial candidate commit matches the registered fixture lock.
Terminal candidate commit preserves the initial fixture lock.
No external acceptance or benchmark control files are present in the candidate commit.
Candidate was materialized from exact terminal commit af27d1126d1bb977635d679f3dbfed6a3f868408.
Every evaluated source, fixture test, and banner byte matched the terminal Git blob bytes used by the artifact bundle.

files.content:
[CmdletBinding()]
param()

Set-StrictMode -Version Latest
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'

$scriptPath = Join-Path (Split-Path -Parent $PSScriptRoot) 'src/TaskForge.ps1'
$benchmarkRoot = Split-Path -Parent (Split-Path -Parent $PSScriptRoot)
$temporaryRoot = Join-Path $benchmarkRoot ".scratch/fixture/taskforge-base-$([guid]::NewGuid())"
$dataFile = Join-Path $temporaryRoot 'tasks.json'
$templateFile = Join-Path $temporaryRoot 'tasks.templates.json'
$bannerFile = Join-Path (Split-Path -Parent $PSScriptRoot) 'assets/template.txt'
$failures = [System.Collections.Generic.List[string]]::new()

function Assert-True {
    param([bool]$Condition, [string]$Message)
    if (-not $Condition) {
        $failures.Add($Message)
    }
}

function Invoke-TaskForge {
    param([string[]]$Arguments)
    $output = @(& $PSHOME\pwsh -NoProfile -File $scriptPath @Arguments 2>&1)
    [pscustomobject]@{
        ExitCode = $LASTEXITCODE
        Output = ($output -join "`n")
    }
}

try {
    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $temporaryRoot -Force | Out-Null

    $add = Invoke-TaskForge @('add', '--title', 'First task', '--description', 'Fixture test', '--data-file', $dataFile, '--json')
    Assert-True ($add.ExitCode -eq 0) 'add should succeed'
    $added = $add.Output | ConvertFrom-Json
    Assert-True ($added.id -eq 1 -and $added.status -eq 'pending') 'add should return a pending task with ID 1'

    $list = Invoke-TaskForge @('list', '--data-file', $dataFile, '--json')
    Assert-True ($list.ExitCode -eq 0) 'list should succeed'
    Assert-True (@($list.Output | ConvertFrom-Json).Count -eq 1) 'list should return the stored task'

    $complete = Invoke-TaskForge @('complete', '--id', '1', '--data-file', $dataFile, '--json')
    Assert-True ($complete.ExitCode -eq 0) 'complete should succeed'
    Assert-True (($complete.Output | ConvertFrom-Json).status -eq 'completed') 'complete should persist completed status'

    $missing = Invoke-TaskForge @('complete', '--id', '99', '--data-file', $dataFile)
    Assert-True ($missing.ExitCode -ne 0) 'completing an unknown task should fail'

    $remove = Invoke-TaskForge @('remove', '--id', '1', '--data-file', $dataFile, '--json')
    Assert-True ($remove.ExitCode -eq 0) 'remove should succeed'
    Assert-True (($remove.Output | ConvertFrom-Json).removedId -eq 1) 'remove should report the removed ID'

    $empty = Invoke-TaskForge @('list', '--data-file', $dataFile)
    Assert-True ($empty.Output -eq 'No tasks.') 'empty list should have stable text'

    $help = Invoke-TaskForge @('help')
    Assert-True ($help.ExitCode -eq 0 -and $help.Output.Contains('TaskForge')) 'help should succeed'

    $saveZebra = Invoke-TaskForge @(
        'template', 'save', '--name', 'Zebra', '--title', 'From zebra',
        '--description', 'Template description', '--data-file', $dataFile, '--json'
    )
    Assert-True ($saveZebra.ExitCode -eq 0) 'template save should succeed'
    Assert-True (($saveZebra.Output | ConvertFrom-Json).name -eq 'Zebra') 'template save should return JSON without a banner'

    $saveAlpha = Invoke-TaskForge @(
        'template', 'save', '--name', 'alpha', '--title', 'From alpha', '--data-file', $dataFile
    )
    Assert-True ($saveAlpha.ExitCode -eq 0) 'non-JSON template save should succeed'
    $banner = (Get-Content -LiteralPath $bannerFile -Raw).TrimEnd("`r", "`n")
    Assert-True ($saveAlpha.Output.StartsWith($banner)) 'non-JSON template save should start with the banner'
    Assert-True (($saveAlpha.Output.Split("`n").Count - 12) -eq 1) 'non-JSON template save should display one 12-line banner'

    $templateList = Invoke-TaskForge @('template', 'list', '--data-file', $dataFile, '--json')
    $listedTemplates = @($templateList.Output | ConvertFrom-Json)
    Assert-True ($templateList.ExitCode -eq 0 -and $listedTemplates.Count -eq 2) 'template list should return saved templates'
    Assert-True ($listedTemplates[0].name -eq 'alpha' -and $listedTemplates[1].name -eq 'Zebra') 'template list should be alphabetically stable'
    Assert-True ($templateList.Output -notmatch '(?m)^\+') 'JSON template list should not contain the banner'

    $textTemplateList = Invoke-TaskForge @('template', 'list', '--data-file', $dataFile)
    Assert-True (
        $textTemplateList.ExitCode -eq 0 -and
        [regex]::Matches($textTemplateList.Output, 'TEMPLATE CONTROL CENTER').Count -eq 1
    ) 'non-JSON template list should display the banner once'

    $duplicate = Invoke-TaskForge @(
        'template', 'save', '--name', 'ALPHA', '--title', 'Duplicate', '--data-file', $dataFile
    )
    Assert-True ($duplicate.ExitCode -ne 0) 'template names should be case-insensitively unique'
    Assert-True (@((Get-Content -LiteralPath $templateFile -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json)).Count -eq 2) 'duplicate template save should not modify templates'

    $invalid = Invoke-TaskForge @(
        'template', 'save', '--name', '../bad', '--title', 'Invalid', '--data-file', $dataFile
    )
    Assert-True ($invalid.ExitCode -ne 0) 'invalid template names should be rejected'
    Assert-True (@((Get-Content -LiteralPath $templateFile -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json)).Count -eq 2) 'invalid template save should not modify templates'

    $templatedAdd = Invoke-TaskForge @('add', '--template', 'zEbRa', '--data-file', $dataFile, '--json')
    $templatedTask = $templatedAdd.Output | ConvertFrom-Json
    Assert-True (
        $templatedAdd.ExitCode -eq 0 -and $templatedTask.title -eq 'From zebra' -and
        $templatedTask.description -eq 'Template description'
    ) 'add --template should inherit title and description case-insensitively'

    $overrideAdd = Invoke-TaskForge @(
        'add', '--template', 'Zebra', '--title', 'Override title',
        '--description', 'Override description', '--data-file', $dataFile, '--json'
    )
    $overrideTask = $overrideAdd.Output | ConvertFrom-Json
    Assert-True (
        $overrideAdd.ExitCode -eq 0 -and $overrideTask.title -eq 'Override title' -and
        $overrideTask.description -eq 'Override description'
    ) 'explicit add values should override template values'

    $taskCount = @((Get-Content -LiteralPath $dataFile -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json)).Count
    $missingTemplate = Invoke-TaskForge @('add', '--template', 'missing', '--data-file', $dataFile)
    Assert-True ($missingTemplate.ExitCode -ne 0) 'add should reject missing templates'
    Assert-True (@((Get-Content -LiteralPath $dataFile -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json)).Count -eq $taskCount) 'missing templates should not modify tasks'

    $removeTemplate = Invoke-TaskForge @('template', 'remove', '--name', 'ZEBRA', '--data-file', $dataFile, '--json')
    Assert-True (
        $removeTemplate.ExitCode -eq 0 -and ($removeTemplate.Output | ConvertFrom-Json).removedName -eq 'Zebra'
    ) 'template remove should match names case-insensitively'

    $missingRemove = Invoke-TaskForge @('template', 'remove', '--name', 'Zebra', '--data-file', $dataFile)
    Assert-True ($missingRemove.ExitCode -ne 0) 'removing a missing template should fail'
    Assert-True (@((Get-Content -LiteralPath $templateFile -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json)).Count -eq 1) 'missing removal should not modify templates'

    $textRemove = Invoke-TaskForge @('template', 'remove', '--name', 'alpha', '--data-file', $dataFile)
    Assert-True (
        $textRemove.ExitCode -eq 0 -and
        [regex]::Matches($textRemove.Output, 'TEMPLATE CONTROL CENTER').Count -eq 1
    ) 'non-JSON template remove should display the banner once'

    $bannerLines = @(Get-Content -LiteralPath $bannerFile)
    Assert-True ($bannerLines.Count -eq 12) 'template banner should have exactly 12 lines'
    Assert-True (-not ($bannerLines | Where-Object { $_.Length -lt 20 -or $_.Length -gt 48 })) 'template banner lines should be 20-48 characters'
    Assert-True (-not ($bannerLines | Where-Object { $_ -match '[^A-Z0-9 +|/\\_*\.#():=-]' })) 'template banner should use only allowed ASCII characters'
    Assert-True (($bannerLines -join "`n").Contains('TEMPLATE')) 'template banner should contain TEMPLATE'
    Assert-True (-not ($bannerLines | Where-Object { $_ -match '\s$' })) 'template banner should not have trailing whitespace'
    $bannerBytes = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllBytes($bannerFile)
    Assert-True ($bannerBytes[-1] -eq 10 -and $bannerBytes[-2] -ne 10 -and $bannerBytes -notcontains 13) 'template banner should end with exactly one LF newline'

    if ($failures.Count -gt 0) {
        $failures | ForEach-Object { [Console]::Error.WriteLine("FAIL: $_") }
        exit 1
    }
    "PASS: base and template fixture assertions"
}
finally {
    Remove-Item -LiteralPath $temporaryRoot -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
}
